risks.description: Buyers may agree the workflow is painful without paying for a separate Integrity Gate service.
risks.mitigation: Require priced-scope, procurement or paid-pilot evidence before treating demand as validated.
risks.trigger: Three qualified conversations produce interest but no concrete commitment.

risks.description: False positives or messy inputs may consume more expert review time than the service saves.
risks.mitigation: Measure review minutes, unresolved-authority rate and input-preparation time on every controlled pilot.
risks.trigger: Human review exceeds the baseline manual reconciliation time or repeated input normalization dominates delivery.
risks.review_point: after the first controlled real or qualified dry-run case

risks.description: A user may misread an automated PASS as regulatory approval or release authorization.
risks.mitigation: Keep the human-review gate and explicit work-product-only release boundary in software and public copy.
risks.trigger: Any copy, output or buyer statement equates PASS with legal/regulatory compliance or release authority.
risks.review_point: before every material public or client-facing Integrity Gate change
